text: On October 11 and 12, 2023, City Council considered item ST3.1 and adopted the 2024 meeting schedule for City Council and its Committees. On November 27, 2023, the Board of Health considered item HL8.5 and adopted the Board's 2024 Schedule of Meetings. The schedule of meetings for the Board of Health – Strategic Plan Development Committee has been developed to avoid dates, whenever possible, that conflict with the approved City Council schedule; and to avoid days of cultural or religious significance. The Chair has scheduled the following meetings of the Board of Health – Strategic Plan Development Committee for 2024: Date: February 16, 2024 Time: 9:30am Date: April 22, 2024 Time: 9:30am Date: June 4, 2024 Time: 9:30am
The Board of Health – Strategic Plan Development Committee: 1. Adopted the following meeting dates: - February 5, 2024 at 9:30 a.m. - April 24, 2024 at 9:30 a.m. - June 4, 2024 at 9:30 a.m.
